title: Daily stand-up
intro: In a stand-up, keep it short: what you did yesterday, what you'll do today, and anything blocking you.
introNative: Stand-up में बात short रखें: कल आपने क्या किया, आज क्या करेंगे, और कोई blocker है तो वह।

phrases.text: Yesterday I completed the login API and raised a PR for review.
phrases.native: कल मैंने login API complete किया और review के लिए PR raise किया।
phrases.note: Use the simple past for yesterday: "completed", "raised".

phrases.text: Today I'll be working on the unit tests for the payment service.
phrases.native: आज मैं payment service के unit tests पर काम करूँगा।
phrases.note: "I'll be working on" sounds natural for your plan for the day.

phrases.text: I'm blocked on the API keys and need help from the DevOps team.
phrases.native: API keys की वजह से मेरा काम रुका हुआ है और मुझे DevOps team की help चाहिए।
phrases.note: Say what is blocking you and who can unblock it.

phrases.native: मेरी तरफ़ से कोई blocker नहीं है।
phrases.note: A short, common way to end your update.

phrases.text: Let's take this offline after the stand-up.
phrases.native: इस पर stand-up के बाद अलग से बात करते हैं।
phrases.note: "Take it offline" means discuss it separately, not in the group call.

steps.prompt: Your Scrum Master asks for your update. Which opening sounds most natural?
steps.promptNative: Scrum Master आपका update पूछते हैं। कौन-सी शुरुआत सबसे natural लगती है?
options: Yesterday I completed the login API and raised a PR for review.
Yesterday itself I finished login API work only.
Yesterday I was doing the login API and all.
steps.answer: Yesterday I completed the login API and raised a PR for review.
steps.explanation: Say clearly what you finished, using the simple past.
steps.explanationNative: आपने क्या पूरा किया, वह simple past में साफ़-साफ़ बताइए।

steps.promptNative: आज मैं payment service के unit tests पर काम करूँगा।
steps.answer: Today I'll be working on the unit tests for the payment service.

steps.audioText: I'm blocked on the API keys and need help from the DevOps team.
options: I'm blocked on the API keys and need help from the testing team.
I'm blocked on the API keys and need help from the DevOps team.
I've unblocked the API keys with help from the DevOps team.
steps.answer: I'm blocked on the API keys and need help from the DevOps team.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: I am having one blocker in the payment module.
options: I am having one blocker in the payment module.
I have a blocker in the payment module.
I am having a blocker in payment module.
I have one blocker on payment module itself.
steps.answer: I have a blocker in the payment module.
steps.explanation: When "have" means possess, don't use the -ing form: say "I have", not "I am having".
steps.explanationNative: जब "have" का मतलब 'पास होना' हो, तो -ing form इस्तेमाल न करें: "I have" कहें, "I am having" नहीं।

steps.prompt: A teammate starts a long technical debate during the stand-up. What do you say?
steps.promptNative: Stand-up के बीच में एक teammate लंबी technical बहस शुरू कर देता है। आप क्या कहेंगे?
options: This is not the place, stop it.
Let's take this offline after the stand-up.
We will discuss about this later.
steps.answer: Let's take this offline after the stand-up.
steps.explanation: "Take this offline" keeps the stand-up short without sounding rude.
steps.explanationNative: "Take this offline" कहने से stand-up short रहता है और rude भी नहीं लगता।

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: Since two days I am working on this bug.
options: Since two days I am working on this bug.
I've been working on this bug for two days.
I am working on this bug since two days.
I have been working on this bug since two days.
steps.answer: I've been working on this bug for two days.
steps.explanation: For something still going on, use "I've been working" with "for" and a length of time.
steps.explanationNative: जो काम अभी भी चल रहा है, उसके लिए "I've been working" के साथ "for" और समय की अवधि इस्तेमाल करें।

steps.promptNative: मेरी तरफ़ से कोई blocker नहीं है।

steps.audioText: Let's take this offline after the stand-up.
options: Let's take this off the list after the stand-up.
Let's talk about this after the stand-up.
Let's take this offline after the stand-up.
steps.answer: Let's take this offline after the stand-up.

steps.prompt: Give your real stand-up update out loud in 3 sentences: what you completed yesterday, what you'll work on today, and any blockers.
steps.promptNative: अपना असली stand-up update 3 sentences में बोलकर दीजिए: कल क्या complete किया, आज किस पर काम करेंगे, और कोई blocker।
